description: This file defines the GrainTypeOptions class for configuring grain types in an Orleans project, along with a default provider and validator classes for these options. It manages collections of grain class and interface types, implements configuration logic, and validation functionalities for grain type configuration.

classes.name: GrainTypeOptions
classes.description: Holds collections of grain classes and interfaces metadata.

classes.name: DefaultGrainTypeOptionsProvider
classes.description: Provides default configuration for GrainTypeOptions by populating class and interface types based on manifest options.

classes.name: GrainTypeOptionsValidator
classes.description: Validates that the configured grain classes and interfaces meet the necessary criteria for Orleans configuration.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Implements configuration logic for GrainTypeOptions, adding interface and class types based on type manifest options.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Checks whether the grain interface and class collections are properly configured in GrainTypeOptions.
